		var pluginCtx = null;

		function GenericConnCard(props) {
			var conn = props.conn;
			var ctl = props.ctl;
			var fields = conn.authFields || [];
			var fieldStates = {};
			fields.forEach(function (f) { fieldStates[f.ref] = useState(""); });
			var extras = conn.extras || [];
			var topicsState = useState(null);
			var topics = topicsState[0];
			var setTopics = topicsState[1];
			useEffect(function () {
				if (extras.indexOf("default-topic") < 0) return;
				var controller = new AbortController();
				fetch(API + "/topics", { signal: controller.signal, headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
					.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
					.then(function (d) { if (d && d.ok && Array.isArray(d.topics)) setTopics(d.topics); })
					.catch(function () {});
				return function () { controller.abort(); };
			}, []);
			var allConfigured = fields.every(function (f) { return conn.state[f.ref + "Configured"] === true; });
			var anyConfigured = fields.some(function (f) { return conn.state[f.ref + "Configured"] === true; });
			var status = allConfigured ? (conn.state.enabled ? "已连接" : "已断开") : (anyConfigured ? "凭证不完整" : "未配置");
			if (conn.state.credSource === "cli") status = conn.state.enabled ? "已连接（CLI 登录态）" : "已断开";
			else if (conn.state.cliAuthed && !allConfigured) status = "CLI 已登录（将自动回退）";
			var statusCls = (allConfigured || conn.state.credSource === "cli" || conn.state.cliAuthed) && conn.state.enabled !== false ? "whBadgeOn" : "whBadgeOff";
			var save = function () {
				var jobs = [];
				fields.forEach(function (f) {
					var v = fieldStates[f.ref][0];
					if (v && v.trim()) jobs.push({ ref: f.ref, value: v.trim() });
				});
				if (jobs.length === 0) { ctl.setErr("请至少填写一项"); return; }
				ctl.saveCreds(jobs);
			};
			var rows = [];
			if (extras.indexOf("model-invoke") >= 0) rows.push(React.createElement("div", { className: "whRow", key: "mi" },
				React.createElement("div", null,
					React.createElement("div", { className: "whRowLabel" }, "模型自动调用"),
					React.createElement("div", { className: "whRowHint" }, "关闭时模型仅在用户点名时使用该连接")
				),
				React.createElement("button", {
					className: "whSwitch" + (conn.state.modelInvoke ? " whSwitchOn" : ""),
					disabled: ctl.busy,
					onClick: function () { ctl.toggleModelInvoke(conn.id, !conn.state.modelInvoke); },
					"aria-label": "模型自动调用"
				}, React.createElement("span", { className: "whSwitchKnob" }))
			));
			if (extras.indexOf("default-topic") >= 0) rows.push(React.createElement("div", { className: "whField", key: "dt" },
				React.createElement("span", { className: "whFieldLabel" }, "默认知识库（getnote_save 未显式指定库时落入）"),
				React.createElement("select", {
					className: "whInput",
					value: conn.state.defaultTopicId || "",
					disabled: ctl.busy,
					onChange: function (e) { ctl.setDefaultTopic(e.target.value); }
				},
					React.createElement("option", { value: "" }, "不设默认（默认库）"),
					(topics || []).map(function (t) {
						return React.createElement("option", { value: t.id, key: t.id }, t.name + "（" + (t.noteCount ?? 0) + " 笔记）");
					})
				)
			));
			var buttons = [];
			buttons.push(React.createElement("button", { className: "whBtn", key: "save", disabled: ctl.busy, onClick: save }, "保存凭证"));
			buttons.push(React.createElement("button", { className: "whBtn whBtnGhost", key: "probe", disabled: ctl.busy, onClick: function () { ctl.probeConn(conn.id); } }, "测试连接"));
			if (extras.indexOf("oauth-button") >= 0) buttons.push(React.createElement("button", { className: "whBtn whBtnGhost", key: "oauth", disabled: ctl.busy, onClick: ctl.authLogin }, "浏览器授权登录"));
			if (conn.platformUrl) buttons.push(React.createElement("button", { className: "whBtn whBtnGhost", key: "open", disabled: ctl.busy, onClick: function () { ctl.openUrl(conn.platformUrl); } }, "打开管理后台"));
			return React.createElement("div", { className: "whCard", key: conn.id },
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whCardHead" },
					conn.logo ? React.createElement("img", { className: "whLogo", src: conn.logo, alt: "" }) : null,
					React.createElement("div", { className: "whTitleWrap" },
						React.createElement("span", { className: "whTitle" }, conn.title),
						React.createElement("span", { className: "whSubtitle" }, conn.subtitle || "")
					),
					React.createElement("div", { className: "whSpacer" }),
					React.createElement("span", { className: "whBadge " + statusCls }, status)
				),
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whChips" },
					(conn.capabilities || []).map(function (cap) { return React.createElement("span", { className: "whChip", key: cap }, cap); })
				),
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whRow" },
					React.createElement("div", null,
						React.createElement("div", { className: "whRowLabel" }, "连接开关"),
						React.createElement("div", { className: "whRowHint" }, conn.kind === "mcp" ? "联动 MCP 条目，重启后生效" : "关闭后工具立即返回「已断开」")
					),
					React.createElement("button", {
						className: "whSwitch" + (conn.state.enabled ? " whSwitchOn" : ""),
						disabled: ctl.busy,
						onClick: function () { ctl.toggleConn(conn.id, !conn.state.enabled); },
						"aria-label": "连接开关"
					}, React.createElement("span", { className: "whSwitchKnob" }))
				),
				rows,
				fields.map(function (f) {
					var st = fieldStates[f.ref];
					return React.createElement("div", { className: "whField", key: f.ref },
						React.createElement("span", { className: "whFieldLabel" }, f.label),
						React.createElement("input", {
							className: "whInput",
							type: f.secret ? "password" : "text",
							placeholder: conn.state[f.ref + "Configured"] ? "已配置（留空则不变）" : f.placeholder,
							value: st[0],
							onChange: function (e) { st[1](e.target.value); }
						})
					);
				}),
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whBtns" }, buttons),
				ctl.probeText ? React.createElement("pre", { className: "whQuota" }, ctl.probeText) : null,
				conn.note ? React.createElement("div", { className: "whHint" }, conn.note) : null
			);
		}

		function ToolZone(props) {
			var s = props.s;
			var meta = s.toolMeta;
			var caps = s.capabilities || [];
			var tools = meta && Array.isArray(meta.tools) ? meta.tools : [];
			var count = tools.length > 0 ? tools.length : (s.toolCount || 0);
			var expandedState = useState(false);
			var expanded = expandedState[0];
			var setExpanded = expandedState[1];
			// 场景分组：按 meta.scenes 顺序，未命中场景归「其他」；组内只读在前、写入在后
			var sceneOrder = meta && Array.isArray(meta.scenes) && meta.scenes.length > 0 ? meta.scenes : [];
			var groups = [];
			var groupMap = {};
			tools.forEach(function (t) {
				var sc = t.scene || "其他";
				if (!groupMap[sc]) { groupMap[sc] = { scene: sc, tools: [] }; groups.push(groupMap[sc]); }
				groupMap[sc].tools.push(t);
			});
			groups.sort(function (a, b) {
				var ia = sceneOrder.indexOf(a.scene); if (ia === -1) ia = 9999;
				var ib = sceneOrder.indexOf(b.scene); if (ib === -1) ib = 9999;
				return ia - ib;
			});
			groups.forEach(function (g) {
				g.tools.sort(function (a, b) {
					return (a.readWrite === "write" ? 1 : 0) - (b.readWrite === "write" ? 1 : 0);
				});
			});
			return React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolZone", "data-plugin": "dsh-wanzh-hulian" },
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolZoneHead" },
					React.createElement("span", { className: "whToolCount" }, count + " 个工具 · mcp__" + s.id + "_*"),
					tools.length > 0
						? React.createElement("button", { className: "whToolExpand", onClick: function () { setExpanded(!expanded); } },
							expanded ? "收起能力清单 ▴" : "查看全部 " + count + " 项能力 ▾")
						: null
				),
				meta && meta.example
					? React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolExample" },
							React.createElement("span", { className: "whToolExampleTag" }, "对模型说"),
							"「" + meta.example + "」")
					: null,
				caps.length > 0
					? React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolChips" },
						caps.map(function (cap) { return React.createElement("span", { className: "whToolChip", key: cap }, cap); }))
					: null,
				expanded && tools.length > 0
					? React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolList" },
						groups.map(function (g) {
							return React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolGroup", key: g.scene },
								React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolGroupTitle" }, g.scene + " · " + g.tools.length),
								g.tools.map(function (t) {
									var bizName = t.businessName || t.name;
									var desc = t.businessDesc || t.description;
									var badge = t.readWrite === "write"
										? React.createElement("span", { className: "whToolBadge", title: "写入/删除操作：执行前需向用户确认，且需店铺授予对应写权限" }, "写入")
										: null;
									return React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolRow", key: t.name },
										React.createElement("div", { className: "whToolTitle" },
											React.createElement("span", { className: "whToolName" }, bizName),
											badge,
											React.createElement("span", { className: "whToolModel" }, "mcp__" + s.id + "_" + t.name)
										),
										desc ? React.createElement("span", { className: "whToolDesc" }, desc) : null
									);
								}));
						}))
					: null,
				meta && meta.instructions
					? React.createElement("p", { className: "whGuide" }, meta.instructions)
					: null
			);
		}

		function McpBoard(props) {
			var ctl = props.ctl;
			var serversState = useState(null);
			var servers = serversState[0];
			var setServers = serversState[1];
			useEffect(function () {
				var controller = new AbortController();
				fetch(API + "/mcp-servers", { signal: controller.signal, headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
					.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
					.then(function (d) { if (d && d.ok) setServers(d.servers || []); })
					.catch(function () {});
				return function () { controller.abort(); };
			}, []);
			if (!servers) return React.createElement("span", { className: "whHint" }, "加载中…");
			return React.createElement("div", { className: "whGrid" },
				servers.map(function (s) {
					var st = s.state;
					var statusText = s.enabled ? (st && st.status === "running" ? "运行中" : st && st.status === "error" ? "启动失败" : "待重启生效") : "未启用";
					var statusCls = s.enabled ? (st && st.status === "error" ? "whBadgeOff" : "whBadgeOn") : "whBadgeOff";
					return React.createElement("div", { className: "whCard", key: s.id },
						React.createElement("div", { className: "whCardHead" },
							React.createElement("div", { className: "whTitleWrap" },
								React.createElement("span", { className: "whTitle" }, s.name),
								React.createElement("span", { className: "whSubtitle" }, (s.transport === "streamable-http" ? "HTTP · " + s.url : "stdio · " + s.command + " " + (s.args || []).join(" ")))
							),
							React.createElement("div", { className: "whSpacer" }),
							React.createElement("span", { className: "whBadge " + statusCls }, statusText)
						),
						React.createElement("div", { className: "whRow" },
							React.createElement("div", null,
								React.createElement("div", { className: "whRowLabel" }, "启用"),
								React.createElement("div", { className: "whRowHint" }, "工具以 mcp__" + s.id + "__<tool> 注册；变更需重启 DSH 生效")
							),
						s.auth && s.auth.type === "oauth-pkce"
							? React.createElement("div", { className: "whBtns", key: "oauth" },
								React.createElement("button", { className: "whBtn whBtnGhost", disabled: ctl.busy, onClick: function () { ctl.oauthStart(s.id); } }, "浏览器授权"),
								React.createElement("button", { className: "whBtn whBtnGhost", disabled: ctl.busy, onClick: ctl.oauthStatus }, "刷新授权状态")
							)
							: null,
						ctl.oauthText && s.auth && s.auth.type === "oauth-pkce"
							? React.createElement("pre", { className: "whQuota", key: "ot" }, ctl.oauthText)
							: null,
							React.createElement("button", {
								className: "whSwitch" + (s.enabled ? " whSwitchOn" : ""),
								disabled: ctl.busy,
								onClick: function () { ctl.toggleMcp(s.id, !s.enabled); },
								"aria-label": "启用"
							}, React.createElement("span", { className: "whSwitchKnob" }))
						),
						st && st.status === "error" ? React.createElement("div", { className: "whErr" }, st.error || "启动失败") : null,
						React.createElement(ToolZone, { s: s, key: "tools" }),
						s.note ? React.createElement("div", { className: "whHint" }, s.note) : null
					);
				})
			);
		}

		function WanzhPage() {
			var loadResult = useState({ boards: [], connections: [] });
			var board = useState("knowledge");
			var busy = useState(false);
			var err = useState("");
			var probeText = useState("");
			var data = loadResult[0];
			var setData = loadResult[1];
			var active = board[0];
			var setActive = board[1];
			var setBusy = busy[1];
			var setErr = err[1];
			var setProbeText = probeText[1];

			useEffect(function () {
				var controller = new AbortController();
				fetch(API + "/list", { signal: controller.signal, headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
					.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
					.then(function (d) { if (d && d.ok) setData({ boards: d.boards || [], connections: d.connections || [] }); })
					.catch(function (e) { if (e && e.name !== "AbortError") setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); });
				return function () { controller.abort(); };
			}, []);

			var ctl = {
				busy: busy[0],
				err: err[0],
				probeText: probeText[0],
				refresh: function () {
					fetch(API + "/list", { headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) { if (d && d.ok) setData({ boards: d.boards || [], connections: d.connections || [] }); });
				},
				toggle: function (field, value) {
					setBusy(true); setErr("");
					fetch(API + "/toggle", {
						method: "POST",
						headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
						body: JSON.stringify({ id: "getnote-brain", field: field, value: value })
					})
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (d && d.ok) ctl.refresh();
							else setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "切换失败");
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},

				oauthStart: function (id) {
					setBusy(true); setErr(""); setProbeText("");
					fetch(API + "/oauth/start", {
						method: "POST",
						headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
						body: JSON.stringify({ id: id })
					})
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (d && d.ok) { setProbeText(d.hint || "授权页已打开"); ctl.oauthStatus(); }
							else setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "授权发起失败");
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				oauthStatus: function () {
					fetch(API + "/oauth/status", { headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (!d) return;
							if (!d.authed) setProbeText("未授权：点击「浏览器授权」完成 PixPix OAuth（授权后重启 DSH 生效）。");
							else setProbeText("已授权 ✓ scope: " + (d.scope || "-") + (d.expired ? "（令牌已过期，重启时自动刷新）" : "（" + new Date(d.expiresAt).toLocaleString() + " 到期）"));
						})
						.catch(function () {});
				},
				toggleMcp: function (id, enabled) {
					setBusy(true); setErr("");
					fetch(API + "/mcp-servers", {
						method: "POST",
						headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
						body: JSON.stringify({ id: id, enabled: enabled })
					})
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (d && d.ok) {
								setErr(d.hint || "已保存（重启后生效）");
								fetch(API + "/mcp-servers", { headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
									.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
									.then(function (dd) { if (dd && dd.ok) setData(function (prev) { return prev; }); });
							} else setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "保存失败");
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				setErr: function (msg) { setErr(msg); },
				saveCreds: function (jobs) {
					setBusy(true); setErr("");
					Promise.all(jobs.map(function (j) {
						return fetch(API + "/credential", {
							method: "POST",
							headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
							body: JSON.stringify(j)
						}).then(function (r) { return r.json(); });
					}))
						.then(function (rs) {
							var bad = rs.filter(function (d) { return !d || !d.ok; });
							if (bad.length > 0) setErr(bad[0] && bad[0].error ? bad[0].error : "保存失败");
							else ctl.refresh();
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				toggleConn: function (id, value) {
					setBusy(true); setErr("");
					fetch(API + "/toggle", {
						method: "POST",
						headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
						body: JSON.stringify({ id: id, field: "enabled", value: value })
					})
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (d && d.ok) { setErr(d.hint || "已保存"); ctl.refresh(); }
							else setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "切换失败");
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				probeConn: function (id) {
					setBusy(true); setErr(""); setProbeText("");
					fetch(API + "/probe", {
						method: "POST",
						headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
						body: JSON.stringify({ id: id })
					})
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (!d || !d.ok) { setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "连接测试失败"); return; }
							setProbeText(d.text || "连接测试通过 ✓");
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				toggleModelInvoke: function (id, value) {
					setBusy(true); setErr("");
					fetch(API + "/toggle", {
						method: "POST",
						headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
						body: JSON.stringify({ id: id, field: "modelInvoke", value: value })
					})
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (d && d.ok) ctl.refresh();
							else setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "切换失败");
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				authLogin: function () {
					setBusy(true); setErr("");
					fetch(API + "/auth-login", { method: "POST", headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (d && d.ok) setErr(d.hint || "已触发浏览器授权");
							else setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "授权触发失败");
							ctl.refresh();
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				openUrl: function (url) {
					setBusy(true); setErr("");
					fetch(API + "/open", {
						method: "POST",
						headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
						body: JSON.stringify({ url: url })
					})
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) { if (!d || !d.ok) setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "打开失败"); })
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				setDefaultTopic: function (topicId) {
					setBusy(true); setErr("");
					fetch(API + "/default-topic", {
						method: "POST",
						headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
						body: JSON.stringify({ topicId: topicId })
					})
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (d && d.ok) ctl.refresh();
							else setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "默认库保存失败");
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				},
				probe: function () {
					setBusy(true); setErr(""); setProbeText("");
					fetch(API + "/probe", { method: "POST", headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
						.then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
						.then(function (d) {
							if (!d || !d.ok) {
								setErr(d && d.error ? d.error : "连接测试失败");
								return;
							}
							var lines = ["连接测试通过 ✓"];
							if (d.quota) {
								var q = d.quota;
								var f = function (b) { return b ? b.used + " / " + b.limit : "-"; };
								lines.push("配额 read 日/月: " + f(q.read && q.read.daily) + " | " + f(q.read && q.read.monthly));
								lines.push("配额 write 日/月: " + f(q.write && q.write.daily) + " | " + f(q.write && q.write.monthly));
							}
							if (d.topics) lines.push("知识库总数: " + d.topics.total + "（本次返回 " + d.topics.count + " 个）");
							setProbeText(lines.join("\n"));
						})
						.catch(function (e) { setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); })
						.finally(function () { setBusy(false); });
				}
			};

			var conns = data.connections.filter(function (c) { return c.board === active; });

			return React.createElement(
				"div",
				{ className: "whRoot", "data-plugin": "dsh-wanzh-hulian" },
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whPills" },
					data.boards.map(function (b) {
						var count = b.connections ? b.connections.length : 0;
						return React.createElement(
							"button",
							{
								className: "whPill" + (b.key === active ? " whPillActive" : ""),
								key: b.key,
								onClick: function () { setActive(b.key); }
							},
							b.icon + " " + b.title,
							count > 0 ? React.createElement("span", { className: "whPillBadge" }, String(count)) : null,
							b.ready ? null : React.createElement("span", { className: "whPillBadge" }, "规划中")
						);
					})
				),
				React.createElement("p", { className: "whBoardDesc" },
					(data.boards.find(function (b) { return b.key === active; }) || {}).desc || ""
				),
				active === "enterprise"
					? React.createElement("div", { className: "whGrid" },
						conns.map(function (c2) {
							if (c2.id === "getnote-brain") return null;
							return React.createElement(GenericConnCard, { conn: c2, ctl: ctl, key: c2.id });
						}))
					: active === "mcp"
					? React.createElement(McpBoard, { ctl: ctl })
					: conns.length > 0
						? React.createElement("div", { className: "whGrid" },
							conns.map(function (c) {
								return React.createElement(GenericConnCard, { conn: c, ctl: ctl, key: c.id });
							}))
						: React.createElement("p", { className: "whBoardDesc" }, "该板块暂无已上线的连接，敬请期待。"),
				ctl.err && !conns.length ? React.createElement("div", { className: "whErr" }, ctl.err) : null
			);
		}

		/* ── 输入区知识库选择器（跨 Slot 共享开关状态） ─────────────────── */
		var kbStore = { open: false, subs: [] };
		function kbSetOpen(next) {
			if (kbStore.open === next) return;
			kbStore.open = next;
			kbStore.subs.forEach(function (fn) { fn(); });
		}
		function useKbOpen() {
			var v = useState(kbStore.open);
			var setV = v[1];
			useEffect(function () {
				var fn = function () { setV(kbStore.open); };
				kbStore.subs.push(fn);
				return function () { kbStore.subs = kbStore.subs.filter(function (x) { return x !== fn; }); };
			}, []);
			return v[0];
		}

		function SidebarKbButton(props) {
			var open = useKbOpen();
			var wide = props && props.wide;
			if (!wide) return null;
			return React.createElement(
				"div",
				{ className: "whSbEntry", "data-plugin": "dsh-wanzh-hulian" },
				React.createElement(
					"button",
					{
						className: "whSbBtn",
						"data-active": open || undefined,
						"aria-pressed": open,
						"aria-label": "知识库",
						onClick: function () { kbSetOpen(!kbStore.open); }
					},
					React.createElement("span", { className: "whSbLabel" }, "知识库")
				)
			);
		}

		function KbRightPanel(props) {
			var open = useKbOpen();
			var topicsState = useState(null);
			var connState = useState(null);
			var errState = useState("");
			var modeState = useState("search");
			var topics = topicsState[0];
			var setTopics = topicsState[1];
			var conn = connState[0];
			var setConn = connState[1];
			var err = errState[0];
			var setErr = errState[1];
			var mode = modeState[0];
			var setMode = modeState[1];
			var loadedRef = useState(false);
			var inputActions = props && props.inputActions;
			var sessionId = props && props.sessionId;
			useEffect(function () {
				if (!open || loadedRef[0]) return;
				loadedRef[1] = true;
				var controller = new AbortController();
				Promise.all([
					fetch(API + "/topics", { signal: controller.signal, headers: { accept: "application/json" } }),
					fetch(API + "/list", { signal: controller.signal, headers: { accept: "application/json" } })
				])
					.then(function (rs) { return Promise.all(rs.map(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })); })
					.then(function (ds) {
						var td = ds[0];
						var conns = (ds[1] && Array.isArray(ds[1].connections) ? ds[1].connections : []).filter(function (c) { return c.board === "knowledge"; });
						if (td && td.ok && Array.isArray(td.topics)) { setTopics(td.topics); setErr(""); }
						else setErr(td && td.error ? td.error : "知识库列表获取失败");
						setConn(conns.length > 0 ? conns[0] : null);
					})
					.catch(function (e) { if (e && e.name !== "AbortError") setErr(String(e && e.message ? e.message : e)); });
				return function () { controller.abort(); };
			}, [open]);
			useEffect(function () {
				if (!open) loadedRef[1] = false;
			}, [open]);
			useEffect(function () {
				var onKey = function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape") kbSetOpen(false); };
				if (open) window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
				return function () { window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey); };
			}, [open]);
			if (!open) return null;
			var pick = function (text) {
				var ok = false;
				if (inputActions && typeof inputActions.setDraft === "function") {
					inputActions.setDraft(text);
					ok = true;
				}
				if (!ok && typeof sessionId === "string") {
					try {
						var sessionsSvc = pluginCtx && pluginCtx.sessions ? pluginCtx.sessions : undefined;
						var actx = sessionsSvc && typeof sessionsSvc.scope === "function" ? sessionsSvc.scope(sessionId) : undefined;
						var conv = actx === undefined ? undefined : actx.get("conversation");
						var face = conv && conv.input && typeof conv.input.for === "function" ? conv.input.for(actx) : undefined;
						if (face && typeof face.setDraft === "function") { face.setDraft(text); ok = true; }
					} catch (e) { ok = false; }
				}
				if (!ok) setErr("无法写入输入框（当前会话不支持自动填入）");
				else { setErr(""); kbSetOpen(false); }
			};
			var cmd = (conn && conn.command) || { slug: "得到大脑", allSearch: "/得到大脑 在全部笔记中搜索：", allSave: "/得到大脑 保存笔记（默认库）：" };
			var cardCommand = function (t) {
				if (t.id === "__all") return mode === "save" ? cmd.allSave : cmd.allSearch;
				if (mode === "save") return "/" + cmd.slug + " 保存到「" + t.name + "」知识库（id: " + t.id + "）：";
				return "/" + cmd.slug + " 在「" + t.name + "」知识库（id: " + t.id + "）搜索：";
			};
			var thumb = function (t) {
				var src = t.id === "__all" ? KB_PLACEHOLDER : (t.cover || KB_PLACEHOLDER);
				return React.createElement("img", { className: "whThumb", src: src, width: 36, height: 36, alt: "", onError: function (e) { if (e.target.src !== KB_PLACEHOLDER) e.target.src = KB_PLACEHOLDER; } });
			};
			var cards = topics
				? [
					React.createElement("div", { className: "whKbCard", key: "__all", onClick: function () { pick(cardCommand({ id: "__all" })); }, title: "全部库 · 全局语义搜索" },
						thumb({ id: "__all" }),
						React.createElement("div", { className: "whKbText" },
							React.createElement("span", { className: "whKbName" }, "全部库"),
							React.createElement("span", { className: "whKbMeta" }, "全局搜索 · " + (conn ? conn.title : ""))
						)
					)
				].concat(topics.map(function (t) {
					return React.createElement("div", {
						className: "whKbCard", key: t.id, onClick: function () { pick(cardCommand(t)); },
						title: t.name + "（id: " + t.id + "）"
					},
						thumb(t),
						React.createElement("div", { className: "whKbText" },
							React.createElement("span", { className: "whKbName" }, t.name),
							React.createElement("span", { className: "whKbMeta" }, (t.noteCount !== null && t.noteCount !== undefined ? t.noteCount + " 篇笔记" : "—") + (conn && conn.title ? " · " + conn.title : ""))
						)
					);
				}))
				: null;
			var subtitle = conn
				? "已连接 1 个来源 · " + (topics ? topics.length : "…") + " 个库"
				: "未连接知识库来源";
			return ReactDOM.createPortal(React.createElement(
				React.Fragment,
				null,
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whBackdrop", "data-plugin": "dsh-wanzh-hulian", onClick: function () { kbSetOpen(false); } }),
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whRightPanel", "data-plugin": "dsh-wanzh-hulian" },
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whRightPanelTop" }),
				React.createElement("div", { className: "whRightPanelHead" },
					React.createElement("p", { className: "whRightPanelTitle" }, "知识库"),
					React.createElement("button", { type: "button", className: "whRightPanelClose", onClick: function () { kbSetOpen(false); }, "aria-label": "关闭知识库面板" }, "✕")
				),
				React.createElement("p", { className: "whRightPanelSub" }, subtitle + " · 选择的是知识库名称，不涉及具体笔记"),
				conn
					? React.createElement("div", { className: "whSeg" },
						React.createElement("button", { className: "whSegBtn" + (mode === "search" ? " whSegOn" : ""), onClick: function () { setMode("search"); } }, "搜索"),
						React.createElement("button", { className: "whSegBtn" + (mode === "save" ? " whSegOn" : ""), onClick: function () { setMode("save"); } }, "存库")
					)
					: null,
				err
					? React.createElement("span", { className: "whErr" }, err)
					: cards
						? React.createElement("div", { className: "whKbGrid" }, cards)
						: React.createElement("span", { className: "whHint" }, "加载中…"),
				React.createElement("p", { className: "whRightPanelHint" },
					mode === "save" ? "点卡将插入「保存到「库名」」指令。" : "点卡将插入「在「库名」中搜索：」指令。",
					"ESC 关闭；连接与默认库在 设置 → 万物互联 管理。"
				)
				)
			), document.body);
		}

		exports.apply = function apply(ctx) {
			pluginCtx = ctx;
			ctx.effect(function () {
				return ctx.locale.register(NS, {
					zh: { nav: "万物互联" },
					en: { nav: "Connections" }
				});
			}, "dsh-wanzh-hulian: locale");
			ctx.effect(function () {
				var style = document.createElement("style");
				style.setAttribute("data-plugin-css", "dsh-wanzh-hulian");
				style.textContent = CSS.join("\n");
				document.head.appendChild(style);
				return function () { style.remove(); };
			}, "dsh-wanzh-hulian: css");
			ctx.slots.inject("settings.section", function () {
				return ctx.slots.register(
					{
						name: "settings.section",
						id: "wanzh-hulian",
						order: 28,
						label: function () {
							return ctx.locale.bind(NS)("nav");
						},
						locale: NS
					},
					WanzhPage
				);
			});
			ctx.slots.inject("sidebar.footer.action", function () {
				return ctx.slots.register(
					{ name: "sidebar.footer.action", id: "getnote-kb-sidebar", order: 30, label: "知识库" },
					SidebarKbButton
				);
			});
			ctx.slots.inject("conversation.input.dock", function () {
				return ctx.slots.register(
					{ name: "conversation.input.dock", id: "getnote-kb-panel", order: 210, label: "知识库面板" },
					KbRightPanel
				);
			});
		};
		return module.exports;
	}
});

<div class="section" id="s1">
  <h2><span class="num">1</span> 概述与设计原则</h2>

  <h3>1.1 什么是 Skill</h3>
  <p>Skill 是 AI Agent 的"上岗证"——一种标准化的能力封装，使 Agent 在特定场景下稳定执行任务、输出高质量结果。Skill 的四个核心特征：</p>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>特征</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>目录而非单文件</strong></td><td>一个 Skill 是一个目录，包含 SKILL.md、脚本、参考文档、模板、评估用例等子模块</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>格式而非普通文档</strong></td><td>具有严格的 YAML frontmatter 供路由系统判定触发，非手写说明</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>可调用而非常驻</strong></td><td>触发时加载使用，用完即走，不常驻上下文</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>渐进式而非一次性全量</strong></td><td>三层洋葱结构，按需加载，最小化上下文占用</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>

  <h3>1.2 设计原则</h3>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>原则</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>渐进式披露</strong></td><td>三层加载：Metadata（始终可见）→ Body（触发后加载）→ Resources（按需读取）</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>描述驱动触发</strong></td><td>description 是路由触发器，决定"何时加载"，而非功能摘要</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>模型适配透明</strong></td><td>核心定义与模型适配层分离，Claude / Kimi / Cursor / dsh / Codex 原生加载</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>简洁优先</strong></td><td>上下文窗口是公共资源，只保留模型容易做错的高信号内容</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 2 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s2">
  <h2><span class="num">2</span> 是否该创建 Skill：入口判断</h2>
  <p>创建 Skill 前须通过三层过滤。任何一层未通过，都不应进入创建流程。</p>

  <h3>2.1 第一层：输出契约四问（Q1-Q4）</h3>
  <pre>Q1: 这个工作会被反复使用吗？               否 → no-skill（一次性任务）
Q2: 有稳定的输出契约吗？                   否 → no-skill（每次产出不同）
Q3: 没有 Skill 时 Agent 会做错吗？         否 → no-skill（通用能力即可）
Q4: 以上三项均通过 → 进入 build 流程</pre>

  <h3>2.2 第二层：Iron Law RED 基线</h3>
  <p>在<strong>不加载任何 Skill</strong> 的条件下，用真实用户 prompt 运行 Agent，记录失败：遗漏步骤、误用工具、格式不一致、理解偏差。输出 RED 报告（失败场景 + 错误模式 verbatim 记录）。</p>
  <div class="callout callout-danger">
    <strong>关键判断：</strong>如果 RED 失败清单为空，说明 Agent 本身就能做对，不应创建 Skill。
  </div>

  <h3>2.3 第三层：设计边界检查</h3>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>不适用场景</th><th>原因</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>通用命令或常识性工具用法</td><td>Agent 默认已知</td></tr>
      <tr><td>系统提示词已覆盖的机械约束</td><td>重复写入</td></tr>
      <tr><td>一次性项目上下文</td><td>无复用价值</td></tr>
      <tr><td>变化过快的外部信息（API 细节等）</td><td>无法维护</td></tr>
      <tr><td>模板填空式流程，无非平凡判断</td><td>同质化，无壁垒</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>

  <h3>2.4 方法论审计</h3>
  <p><strong>高同质化风险信号</strong>（命中 2 项以上为高同质化）：</p>
  <ul>
    <li>方法是公开教科书式流程</li>
    <li>几乎任何 AI 都会给出类似步骤</li>
    <li>主要靠模板填空而非判断</li>
    <li>没有任何行业语境或私有视角</li>
  </ul>
  <p>一个真正有价值的 Skill 应至少命中一项竞争壁垒：</p>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>壁垒类型</th><th>示例</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>私有数据</strong> — 内部 SOP、客服记录、社群数据</td><td>公司内部审批流程</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>行业洞察</strong> — 只有深度从业者才强调的判断</td><td>金融合规特殊要求</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>失败案例</strong> — 常见坑、踩雷点、误判模式</td><td>某类项目 90% 失败的原因</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>反共识框架</strong> — 与通用建议不同但更有效</td><td>不走寻常路但成功的方法</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 3 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s3">
  <h2><span class="num">3</span> 全生命周期总览</h2>
  <p>root-skills 家族覆盖 Skill 从创建到退役的完整生命周期：</p>
  <pre>创建（creator）→ 体检（doctor）→ 评测（eval）→ 放行（check）→ 发布
                                                    ↓ （不达标）
                                           修复（opt）→ 复测 → B 卷门禁 → 交付</pre>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>家族成员</th><th>职责</th><th>触发场景</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>root-skills-creator</strong></td><td>Skill 创建器</td><td>新建 Skill、Iron Law 测试、生成模板</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>root-skills-doctor</strong></td><td>结构医生</td><td>检查目录结构、frontmatter 合规、安全扫描</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>root-skills-eval</strong></td><td>双轨评测师</td><td>出题盲测、六维评分、生成 HTML 报告</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>root-skills-check</strong></td><td>放行闸门 + 知识蒸馏</td><td>发布前核对报告、沉淀经验到知识库</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>root-skills-opt</strong></td><td>副本修复师</td><td>评分 &lt; 85 时自动修复（不碰原文件）</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>root-skills-manage</strong></td><td>家族管理器</td><td>注册表、路由、生命周期、版本管理</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 4 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s4">
  <h2><span class="num">4</span> 目录结构规范</h2>

  <h3>4.1 标准目录布局</h3>
  <pre>skill-name/
├── SKILL.md              # 必需 — 主要技能定义（frontmatter + body）
├── scripts/              # 可选 — 可执行代码（.py .sh .js）
├── references/           # 可选 — 按需加载的参考文档（.md）
├── assets/               # 可选 — 输出资源（templates/ fonts/ images/）
├── eval-reports/         # 可选 — 评估报告输出（.yaml）
└── examples/             # 可选 — 使用示例（.md）</pre>

  <h3>4.2 目录规范要点</h3>
  <ul>
    <li>不再使用 <code>manifest.json</code>：所有元数据放在 SKILL.md 的 YAML frontmatter 中</li>
    <li><strong>目录名 = name 字段</strong>：两者一致，ASCII 为 kebab-case，中文名合法</li>
    <li>README.md 按推荐策略：存在为 recommended，缺失不阻塞验证</li>
    <li>references/ 中的文件应被 SKILL.md 正文引用，避免孤立文件</li>
    <li>scripts/ 中的脚本应可执行，有明确的入口和前置条件</li>
  </ul>
</div>

<!-- ===== 5 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s5">
  <h2><span class="num">5</span> SKILL.md Frontmatter 规范</h2>

  <h3>5.1 完整模板</h3>
  <pre>---
name: skill-name-in-kebab-case
description: |
  [功能描述]。当用户[触发条件1]、[触发条件2]时使用。
  触发词：[关键词1]、[关键词2]、[关键词3]。
version: "1.0.0"
complexity: "standard"          # minimal | standard | complex
author:
  name: "Author Name"
compatibility:
  claude: "native"              # native | bridge | unsupported
  kimi: "native"
  cursor: "native"
  dsh: "native"
  codex: "native"
  gpt: "bridge"
triggers:
  keywords: ["关键词1", "关键词2"]
  phrases: ["具体操作1", "具体操作2"]
  contexts: ["场景1", "场景2"]
---</pre>

  <h3>5.2 字段详解</h3>

  <h4>name（<span class="tag tag-required">必需</span>）</h4>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>规则</th><th>说明</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>格式</td><td>ASCII 为 kebab-case（小写字母、数字、连字符）；中文/Unicode 字母合法</td></tr>
      <tr><td>限制</td><td>无空格、ASCII 无大写/下划线、不以连字符开头或结尾</td></tr>
      <tr><td>一致性</td><td>与目录名一致，中文名禁止改回英文</td></tr>
      <tr><td>示例</td><td><code>pdf-processor</code>、<code>api-integration-helper</code>、<code>品牌声音提取器</code></td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>

  <h4>description（<span class="tag tag-required">必需</span>）</h4>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>规则</th><th>要求</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>目的</td><td>决定 Skill 何时被触发，而非描述功能</td></tr>
      <tr><td>结构</td><td><code>[功能] + [何时使用] + [触发词]</code></td></tr>
      <tr><td>长度</td><td>理想 200–400 字符，最大 1024 字符</td></tr>
      <tr><td>人称</td><td>第三人称（"本技能用于……"）</td></tr>
      <tr><td>禁止</td><td>XML 标签 &lt; &gt;、第二人称（"你可以……"）</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>

  <h4>complexity（<span class="tag tag-optional">推荐</span>）</h4>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>级别</th><th>最大字符数</th><th>references/</th><th>典型场景</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><code>minimal</code></td><td>2000 字符</td><td>不需要</td><td>简单知识型 Skill，一句话指令+固定输出</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>standard</code></td><td>4000 字符</td><td>可选</td><td>大多数 Skill，多步骤但流程清晰</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>complex</code></td><td>8000 字符</td><td>推荐</td><td>复杂工作流，多步骤+分支判断+多参考文档</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>

  <h4>version（<span class="tag tag-optional">推荐</span>）</h4>
  <p>语义化版本：<code>主版本号.次版本号.修订号</code>。主版本号：破坏性变更；次版本号：新功能，向后兼容；修订号：Bug 修复，向后兼容。</p>

  <h4>compatibility（<span class="tag tag-optional">推荐</span>）</h4>
  <p><span class="tag tag-native">native</span> 原生支持（核心联盟：Claude / Kimi / Cursor / dsh / Codex）&nbsp; <span class="tag tag-bridge">bridge</span> 桥接支持（GPT / MiniMax，需转换工具）&nbsp; <code>unsupported</code> 不支持</p>

  <h4>triggers（<span class="tag tag-optional">可选</span>）</h4>
  <p>结构化触发条件，含 keywords、phrases、contexts 字段。从 description 自动提取 triggers 的工具开发中，可手动维护。</p>
</div>

<!-- ===== 6 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s6">
  <h2><span class="num">6</span> Description 写作：CSO 可发现性优化</h2>
  <p>description 是 Skill 最重要的字段——它同时影响 Precision（不要误加载）和 Recall（不要漏加载）。</p>

  <h3>6.1 核心公式</h3>
  <pre>description = [功能描述] + [何时触发] + [触发词]</pre>

  <h3>6.2 正反例对比</h3>
  <div class="desc-grid">
    <div class="desc-card bad">
      <div class="label">✖ 反面教材 — 功能描述而非触发条件</div>
      <pre>description: |
  本工具提供周报生成功能，支持多种格式，
  包含五段式模板。</pre>
    </div>
    <div class="desc-card good">
      <div class="label">✔ 正面教材 — 触发条件优先</div>
      <pre>description: |
  当用户要求生成、汇总周报或周总结时使用。
  触发词：周报、周总结、周报模板、每周汇报、
  weekly report、weekly summary。
  不要用于：日报、项目复盘、单纯润色已有文档。</pre>
    </div>
  </div>

  <h3>6.3 Pushy Description（克服 Undertrigger）</h3>
  <p>Claude 等模型有 undertrigger 倾向——即使 Skill 适用也不一定触发。使用"pushy"风格：</p>
  <div class="desc-grid">
    <div class="desc-card bad">
      <div class="label">✖ 普通 — 可能漏触发</div>
      <pre>description: 帮助构建展示内部数据的仪表盘</pre>
    </div>
    <div class="desc-card good">
      <div class="label">✔ Pushy — 确保触发</div>
      <pre>description: |
  构建展示内部数据的快速仪表盘。
  只要用户提及仪表盘、数据可视化、内部指标，
  或想要展示任何公司数据，即使没明确说"仪表盘"，
  也要确保使用此技能。</pre>
    </div>
  </div>

  <h3>6.4 覆盖多种表达方式</h3>
  <pre>description: |
  处理 PDF 文档的提取、转换和合并。
  当用户提及以下任何内容时使用：
  - "PDF转Word"、"PDF转Excel"、"PDF转Markdown"
  - "提取PDF文字"、"提取PDF内容"、"从PDF复制文字"
  - "合并PDF"、"合并pdf文件"、"把多个PDF合并"
  - 上传 .pdf 文件</pre>

  <h3>6.5 Should / Should Not 说明</h3>
  <pre>description: |
  专业 PDF 文档处理工具。
  当用户需要处理 PDF 文件时使用。
  适用场景：文字提取、格式转换、页面合并拆分。
  不适用场景：图片文件处理（OCR）、纯文本编辑、扫描件处理。</pre>

  <h3>6.6 触发词检查清单</h3>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>检查项</th><th>状态</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>是否包含核心关键词？</td><td>☐</td></tr>
      <tr><td>是否覆盖 3+ 种表达方式？</td><td>☐</td></tr>
      <tr><td>是否有明确的触发场景？</td><td>☐</td></tr>
      <tr><td>是否说明了不适用场景？</td><td>☐</td></tr>
      <tr><td>是否足够 pushy？</td><td>☐</td></tr>
      <tr><td>中英文触发词均有覆盖（如适用）？</td><td>☐</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>

  <h3>6.7 测试触发词</h3>
  <p>创建 10–20 个测试查询：</p>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>Should Trigger</strong>（8–10 个）：直接触发词、同义表达、带上下文的查询、隐含需求</li>
    <li><strong>Should Not Trigger</strong>（5–10 个）：完全不相关查询、边界情况、易混淆领域、邻近但不同的需求</li>
  </ul>
</div>

<!-- ===== 7 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s7">
  <h2><span class="num">7</span> 正文写作规范</h2>

  <h3>7.1 写作风格</h3>
  <p><strong>使用祈使语态（Imperative / Infinitive）</strong>：</p>
  <div class="desc-grid">
    <div class="desc-card good">
      <div class="label">✔ 正确</div>
      <pre>运行脚本验证输入格式。
查阅 references/api-guide.md 获取端点详情。</pre>
    </div>
    <div class="desc-card bad">
      <div class="label">✖ 错误</div>
      <pre>你应该运行脚本验证输入格式。
你可以查阅 references/api-guide.md。</pre>
    </div>
  </div>

  <h3>7.2 正文内容原则</h3>
  <div class="callout">
    <strong>核心原则：</strong>只保留模型容易做错的内容，删除模型本来就会的东西。
  </div>
  <p><strong>保留</strong>：行为改变规则、领域偏好和决策边界、常见失败模式和 gotchas、需要读取资源文件的条件。<br>
  <strong>删除</strong>：通用背景介绍、模型已知的常识、易碎的低价值命令列表、与全局指令重复的内容。</p>

  <h3>7.3 正文推荐结构</h3>
  <pre>## 概述
1–2 句话描述技能的核心价值。

## 适用场景
- 场景1：简要说明

## 核心原则
- 原则1

## 执行步骤
1. 步骤1：说明
2. 步骤2：说明

## 输出格式
- 格式要求：具体说明

## 禁区
- 不编造数据
- 不越界处理

## 资源引用
- `references/patterns.md` - [何时查阅]

## 错误处理
- 常见错误1：症状、原因、解决</pre>

  <h3>7.4 Gotchas（避坑指南）</h3>
  <p>Gotchas 是 Skill 中最有价值的积累。来自真实失败——AI 每次做错，沉淀为一条短小、明确、高信号的经验。</p>
  <pre># 示例：PR 守护 Skill 的 gotchas
- 不要假设可选检查失败会阻塞合并
- 不要在没有读取失败原因之前就建议重跑 CI
- 不要在没有用户审批的情况下合并、推送或重跑工作流
- 不要把代码审查请求当成 PR 守护请求
- 在识别到阻塞项后不要继续轮询</pre>
  <p><strong>Gotchas 增长飞轮</strong>：每次失败加一条 gotcha → 误加载收紧 description 并补负例 → 漏加载补触发词并补正例。</p>

  <h3>7.5 输出格式的锚定效应</h3>
  <p>AI 是概率模型。格式描述越具体，偏差越小。</p>
  <div class="desc-grid">
    <div class="desc-card bad">
      <div class="label">✖ 差 — 太模糊</div>
      <pre>输出表格。</pre>
    </div>
    <div class="desc-card good">
      <div class="label">✔ 好 — 具体锚定</div>
      <pre>输出三列表格：
- 第一列：问题类别
- 第二列：具体描述
- 第三列：修复建议</pre>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 8 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s8">
  <h2><span class="num">8</span> 渐进式披露与内容分配</h2>

  <h3>8.1 三层加载系统</h3>
  <pre>第一层: Metadata（name + description）
  • 始终加载在系统提示中
  • 约 100–200 tokens
  • 决定 Skill 是否触发

                ↓ 触发时加载

第二层: SKILL.md Body
  • 触发时加载
  • 约 1500–2000 tokens
  • 提供核心工作流指导

                ↓ 需要时加载

第三层: Resources（references/、scripts/、assets/）
  • 按需读取
  • 无固定限制
  • 脚本可直接执行，不占用上下文</pre>

  <h3>8.2 内容分配策略</h3>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>层级</th><th>放置内容</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>SKILL.md（核心层）</strong></td><td>核心概念与概述、主要工作流步骤、常用模式与示例、资源引用链接、gotchas</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>references/（扩展层）</strong></td><td>详细的 API 文档、完整的参数说明、边界情况与故障排除、高级配置选项、大型代码示例</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>scripts/（执行层）</strong></td><td>确定性操作（格式验证）、重复执行的代码、需要精确性的计算、外部工具调用</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 9 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s9">
  <h2><span class="num">9</span> 复杂度分级</h2>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>级别</th><th>最大字符数</th><th>references/</th><th>适用场景</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><code>minimal</code></td><td>2000 字符</td><td>不需要</td><td>简单知识型 Skill，一句话指令+固定输出</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>standard</code></td><td>4000 字符</td><td>可选</td><td>大多数 Skill，多步骤但流程清晰</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>complex</code></td><td>8000 字符</td><td>推荐</td><td>复杂工作流，多步骤+分支判断+多参考文档</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
  <p><strong>通用规则</strong>：description 理想 200–400 字符，最大 1024 字符；单个 references/ 文件建议控制在 5000 字符以内；超过限制时将内容移至 references/。</p>
</div>

<div class="section" id="s10">
  <h2><span class="num">10</span> Skill 类型框架</h2>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>类型</th><th>定义</th><th>典型用途</th><th>正文风格</th><th>测试策略</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr>
        <td><strong>Technique</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#64748b;">技术型</span></td>
        <td>有明确输入输出、可重复执行的操作流程</td>
        <td>调试流程、图表制作、数据清洗</td>
        <td>流程导向，步骤顺序明确</td>
        <td>新场景执行题，验证步骤完整且可复现</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td><strong>Pattern</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#64748b;">模式型</span></td>
        <td>思维框架或决策模型</td>
        <td>归因方法、拆解框架、判断标准</td>
        <td>判断导向，分析维度与决策标准</td>
        <td>选择题/归因题，验证判断正确</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
        <td><strong>Reference</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#64748b;">知识型</span></td>
        <td>可检索的知识库</td>
        <td>API 速查、字段规范、配置清单</td>
        <td>检索导向，组织清晰</td>
        <td>检索+应用题，验证信息准确且使用正确</td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 11 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s11">
  <h2><span class="num">11</span> 创建流程（12 步）</h2>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>阶段</th><th>步骤</th><th>产出</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>0. 入口判断</strong></td><td>是否 repeated use + 可复用输出契约？否则走 no-skill</td><td>决策</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>1. 意图对话</strong></td><td>核心分叉问题（每轮最多 1 个，最多 2 轮），非核心自行推断</td><td>需求澄清记录</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>2. 选择模式</strong></td><td>explore / release，决定门禁轻重</td><td>模式选择</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>3. 需求分析</strong></td><td>确定用例、触发词、Skill Type、目标用户</td><td>需求文档</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>4. 架构设计</strong></td><td>选择 complexity 级别，规划目录结构</td><td>目录骨架</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>5. Iron Law RED</strong></td><td>真实运行 without-skill 基线，记录失败输出</td><td>RED 报告</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>6. 编写 SKILL.md</strong></td><td>frontmatter + body + gotchas</td><td>初版 SKILL.md</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>7. Iron Law GREEN</strong></td><td>真实运行 with-skill，断言 PASS/FAIL</td><td>对比验证表</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>8. 添加资源</strong></td><td>scripts/、references/、examples/</td><td>资源文件</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>9. 验证</strong></td><td>validate-skill.py + root-skills-eval 六维评估</td><td>验证报告</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>10. Iron Law REFACTOR</strong></td><td>压力场景变体真实运行</td><td>强化版 SKILL.md</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>11. 评分与优化</strong></td><td>轨道 C ≥ 85？未达标 → root-skills-opt 副本修复</td><td>终版（+ B 卷门禁）</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>12. 桥接</strong></td><td>转换为 GPT/MiniMax 格式（如需要）</td><td>桥接文件</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 12 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s12">
  <h2><span class="num">12</span> Iron Law Testing 严格测试法</h2>
  <p><strong>核心原则</strong>：NO SKILL WITHOUT A FAILING TEST FIRST</p>

  <h3>Phase 1: RED（基线失败）</h3>
  <p><strong>步骤</strong>：不加载目标 Skill，给 subagent 真实任务 → 记录错误行为与原话（verbatim rationalizations）→ 提炼失败模式（漏步骤、乱用工具、格式不一致、理解偏差）。</p>
  <p><strong>输出</strong>：RED 报告（失败场景 + 错误模式 + verbatim 记录）</p>

  <h3>Phase 2: GREEN（最小修复）</h3>
  <p><strong>步骤</strong>：仅针对 RED 暴露的问题写最小内容，避免"想当然的全量堆砌"→ 加载 Skill 重测，逐条对照 RED 基线。</p>
  <p><strong>输出</strong>：初版 SKILL.md + GREEN 对比验证表</p>

  <h3>Phase 3: REFACTOR（加固闭环）</h3>
  <p>用四种施压场景打磨 Skill：</p>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>压力场景</th><th>输入</th><th>期望行为</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>时间压力</strong></td><td>"尽快出报告，简单点就行"</td><td>不能因催得急就丢掉关键步骤或编数据</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>模糊需求</strong></td><td>"帮我弄一下"</td><td>主动追问范围和材料，不瞎猜</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>并行任务</strong></td><td>"顺便把 X 也一起做了"</td><td>不串数据，需澄清归属，不擅自扩大范围</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>异常输入</strong></td><td>空输入 / 超长记录 / 格式错乱</td><td>先校验格式，缺失必填项时主动索要</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
  <p>每种场景至少跑 3 次，连续通过才视为合格。</p>

  <h3>Phase 4: PUBLISH（通过后发布）</h3>
  <p><strong>必须满足</strong>：</p>
  <ul class="checklist">
    <li>RED 基线已记录</li>
    <li>GREEN 修复已验证</li>
    <li>REFACTOR 压力测试通过</li>
    <li>安装路径验证成功</li>
  </ul>
</div>

<!-- ===== 13 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s13">
  <h2><span class="num">13</span> 验证与评测门槛</h2>

  <h3>13.1 结构验证</h3>
  <pre>python scripts/validate-skill.py ./my-skill</pre>
  <p>自动检查项：name 格式合规、description 有功能+触发条件、无 XML 标签、SKILL.md 存在且大小写正确、references/ 文件被引用、scripts/ 脚本可执行、使用祈使语态无第二人称、complexity 已声明且长度符合级别。</p>

  <h3>13.2 root-skills-eval 双轨评测</h3>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>轨道</th><th>内容</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>轨道 A（静态）</strong></td><td>六维深度评估 + loading/routing quality 检查，输出标准化 YAML 报告</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>轨道 B（动态）</strong></td><td>触发盲测：A 卷按复杂度出题 × 3 轮 + B 卷 10 条封印留出</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>轨道 C（综合评分）</strong></td><td>六维 100 分制，封顶后 ≥ 85 为发布线</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>

  <h3>13.3 六维评分（轨道 C）</h3>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>维度</th><th>满分</th><th>考察内容</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><strong>Trigger（触发）</strong></td><td>25</td><td>该加载时加载，不该加载时不误触</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>Output（输出）</strong></td><td>25</td><td>输出格式稳定、内容准确</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>Progressive（渐进式）</strong></td><td>15</td><td>洋葱结构合理，不把所有内容塞进正文</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>Safety（安全）</strong></td><td>15</td><td>禁区明确、不编造、不越界</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>Script（脚本）</strong></td><td>10</td><td>脚本可执行、无硬编码密钥</td></tr>
      <tr><td><strong>Spec（规范）</strong></td><td>10</td><td>frontmatter 格式、目录结构合规</td></tr>
      <tr style="font-weight:700;background:#eef2ff;"><td><strong>合计</strong></td><td><strong>100</strong></td><td>封顶后轨道 C ≥ 85 发布</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>

  <h3>13.4 触发评测（轨道 B）</h3>
  <p><strong>A 卷（按复杂度出题 × 3 轮盲测）</strong>：</p>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>复杂度</th><th>总数</th><th>正例</th><th>负例</th><th>近似命中</th><th>边界情况</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>简单（minimal）</td><td>25</td><td>8</td><td>8</td><td>6</td><td>3</td></tr>
      <tr><td>标准（standard）</td><td>50</td><td>16</td><td>16</td><td>12</td><td>6</td></tr>
      <tr><td>复杂（complex）</td><td>100</td><td>32</td><td>32</td><td>24</td><td>12</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>四类主类型</strong>：正例 / 负例 / 近似命中 / 边界情况（比例 32% / 32% / 24% / 12%）</li>
    <li><strong>叠加标签</strong>：安全（4 类攻击面）与 Skill 组合（不占总数，标注在主类型上）</li>
    <li><strong>调用场景</strong>：斜杠点名，≥ 3 条，不占 A 卷条数</li>
    <li><strong>中英触发</strong>：description 中英文触发词均须出正例；中英混写占原全英文份额</li>
    <li><strong>达标参考线</strong>：P ≥ 0.85、R ≥ 0.85、F1 ≥ 0.90</li>
  </ul>

  <p><strong>B 卷（10 条封印留出）</strong>：</p>
  <ul>
    <li>固定配比：正例 3 / 负例 3 / 近似命中 3 / 边界情况 1</li>
    <li>安全标签 ≥ 2、组合标签 ≥ 2</li>
    <li>仅修复副本交付前开卷做最终门禁</li>
    <li><strong>门禁标准</strong>：F1 ≥ 0.85 且无高危安全误触发（FP）</li>
  </ul>

  <h3>13.5 发布门槛</h3>
  <div class="callout">
    <strong>必备条件</strong>：封顶后轨道 C ≥ 85、调用门槛通过。<br>
    <strong>未达标</strong>：自动进入 root-skills-opt 低分修复（在 <code>{skill}-fix/</code> 副本上修复，源文件只读）→ 重测 → B 卷门禁 → 达标后副本与源并排交付。<br>
    <strong>B 卷未过</strong>：继续修复，不交付。
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 14 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s14">
  <h2><span class="num">14</span> 模式分级：Explore vs Release</h2>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>维度</th><th>Explore（探索）</th><th>Release（发布）</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>适用场景</td><td>个人原型、验证想法、临时工具</td><td>团队共享、对外发布、生产依赖</td></tr>
      <tr><td>意图对话</td><td>1 轮核心问题</td><td>完整核心分叉澄清（≤ 2 轮）</td></tr>
      <tr><td>评测</td><td>至少 1 次 with/without 对比</td><td>完整 RED→GREEN→REFACTOR + 压力场景</td></tr>
      <tr><td>触发测试</td><td>可选</td><td>必须（positive/negative loading evals）</td></tr>
      <tr><td>六维评分</td><td>参考</td><td>必须：封顶后轨道 C ≥ 85 且调用门槛通过</td></tr>
      <tr><td>自动优化</td><td>可选</td><td>未达标必须：opt 只改 <code>{skill}-fix/</code> 副本</td></tr>
      <tr><td>DoD 清单</td><td>简化</td><td>完整</td></tr>
      <tr><td>打包</td><td>不需要</td><td>必须可打包可安装</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  </div>
  <p><strong>选择规则</strong>：默认 explore。升级到 release 的信号——其他人将依赖此 Skill、跨会话/跨项目复用、输出作为交付物提交。</p>
</div>

<!-- ===== 15 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s15">
  <h2><span class="num">15</span> 输出契约</h2>

  <h3>15.1 Build（构建——创建或改进 Skill）</h3>
  <p>交付物：<code>SKILL.md</code>（frontmatter + body）、对齐的接口（description 触发条件与正文一致）、有理由的资源（scripts/references/examples）、边界/门禁小结（做了什么、没做什么、评测结果、剩余风险）。</p>

  <h3>15.2 Audit（审计——评估/诊断现有 Skill）</h3>
  <p>交付物：findings（发现的问题，按严重程度分级）、fixes（修复建议，具体到文件/位置）。<strong>仅当被明确要求时才修改文件</strong>——审计默认只读。</p>

  <h3>15.3 No-Skill（判断不该建）</h3>
  <p>交付物：<strong>零文件</strong> + 理由说明。</p>
  <p>触发条件：一次性任务（无 repeated use）、无稳定输出契约（每次产出不同）、通用命令/常识 Agent 不需要 Skill、模板填空式流程无非平凡判断。</p>

  <div class="callout">
    <strong>入口过滤：</strong>每次"创建 Skill"请求，先跑判断：Q1 反复使用？→ Q2 稳定输出契约？→ Q3 无 Skill 会做错？→ 全通过则进入 build。
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== 16 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s16">
  <h2><span class="num">16</span> 上线前 10 项审查清单</h2>
  <div class="table-wrap">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>审查项</th><th>通过标准</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>1</td><td>真的有必要做成 Skill 吗</td><td>无该 Skill 时 Agent 稳定犯错/误触发/漏触发；非通用命令、一次性上下文、机械约束</td></tr>
      <tr><td>2</td><td>适用/不适用边界是否清楚</td><td>description 明确"何时用"+"何时不用"，相邻场景已列出</td></tr>
      <tr><td>3</td><td>是否先写了 eval</td><td>先有 RED 失败基线（真实运行 without-skill 失败证据），再写正文</td></tr>
      <tr><td>4</td><td>description 是否以触发条件开头</td><td>第一句描述触发时机（"当用户……时使用"），而非功能列表</td></tr>
      <tr><td>5</td><td>是否描述用户意图而非功能</td><td>description 写用户会怎么说/何时需要，而非 Skill 内部能做什么</td></tr>
      <tr><td>6</td><td>SKILL.md 是否只保留高信号内容</td><td>只留行为改变规则、领域判断、gotchas；通用背景/常识已删</td></tr>
      <tr><td>7</td><td>runtime 文件是否有明确读取条件</td><td>references/assets/scripts 何时读取在正文写明，无默认全量加载</td></tr>
      <tr><td>8</td><td>是否定义权限与审批边界</td><td>明确安全边界、危险操作与越权读取的拒绝规则</td></tr>
      <tr><td>9</td><td>是否有 positive/negative/e2e eval</td><td>补齐 positive loading、negative/forbidden loading、boundary 与端到端真实运行评测</td></tr>
      <tr><td>10</td><td>是否准备维护与退役机制</td><td>维护闭环（gotcha 优先）与生命周期状态机（active→deprecated）</td></tr>

<!-- ===== 18 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s18">
  <h2><span class="num">18</span> 最佳实践</h2>

  <h3>18.1 Do's</h3>
  <ol>
    <li>使用具体、可操作的触发短语，覆盖 3+ 种表达方式</li>
    <li>保持 SKILL.md 简洁（&lt; 3000 字，high signal）</li>
    <li>使用祈使语态写作，不写"你应该……"</li>
    <li>为复杂任务提供清晰的步骤和输出格式锚定</li>
    <li>包含错误处理说明和禁区</li>
    <li>测试 Skill 触发准确性（10–20 条查询）</li>
    <li>使用 version 字段追踪变更</li>
    <li>明确声明跨模型兼容性</li>
    <li>在正文中只保留模型容易做错的内容</li>
    <li>每次失败沉淀为 gotcha</li>
  </ol>

  <h3>18.2 Don'ts</h3>
  <ol>
    <li>使用模糊的触发条件（如"帮助处理数据"）</li>
    <li>在 SKILL.md 中放入所有细节（应利用 references/ 拆分）</li>
    <li>使用第二人称（"你应该……"）</li>
    <li>忽略错误处理</li>
    <li>创建无明确用途的 Skill（通过 Iron Law RED 验证）</li>
    <li>为了"过验证"把 README.md 从目录中移走</li>
    <li>在 frontmatter 中使用 XML 标签</li>
    <li>忽略模型特定的限制</li>
    <li>上线后随意拓宽 description 而不补 evals</li>
    <li>把中文 Skill name 改回英文</li>
  </ol>

  <h3>18.3 维护规则</h3>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>gotcha 优先</strong>：AI 失败时先加 gotcha，不改正文结构</li>
    <li><strong>description 收紧</strong>：误加载时收紧 description 并补负例 evals</li>
    <li><strong>description 放宽</strong>：漏加载时补触发词并补正例 evals</li>
    <li>每次拓宽 description 必须补 positive loading 和 negative loading evals</li>
    <li>长期无人触发、内容已进入模型通用能力、领域规则变化过快、与其他 Skill 重叠严重 → 考虑退役</li>
  </ul>
</div>

<!-- ===== 19 ===== -->
<div class="section" id="s19">
  <h2><span class="num">19</span> 常见问题</h2>

  <div class="callout" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
    <strong>Q：什么样的任务适合做成 Skill？</strong><br>
    A：三个条件同时满足——高频重复（每周至少几次）、Agent 现在会做错或遗漏、输出可以标准化。
  </div>
  <div class="callout" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
    <strong>Q：description 到底怎么写？</strong><br>
    A：记住公式——<strong>干什么 + 什么时候触发 + 触发词</strong>。用第三人称，"当用户……时使用"开头。
  </div>
  <div class="callout" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
    <strong>Q：正文写多长合适？</strong><br>
    A：minimal &lt; 2000 字符，standard &lt; 4000 字符，complex &lt; 8000 字符。超过这个数就该拆到 references/。
  </div>
  <div class="callout" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
    <strong>Q：怎么判断 Skill 已经"够好了"？</strong><br>
    A：三个信号——RED 失败清单全部清零、REFACTOR 压力测试全部通过、连续三次使用输出格式一致且无意外。
  </div>
  <div class="callout" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
    <strong>Q：自测评分不达标怎么办？</strong><br>
    A：root-skills-eval 轨道 C &lt; 85 时，自动进入低分修复流程：root-skills-opt 在 <code>{skill}-fix/</code> 副本上修复（原文件不动），修复后重测，达标后通过 B 卷门禁，副本与源文件并排交付。
  </div>
  <div class="callout" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
    <strong>Q：如何决策是否该建这条 Skill？</strong><br>
    A：按三层过滤——输出契约四问（Q1-Q4）→ Iron Law RED 基线（证明 Agent 会失败）→ 设计边界检查（排除通用命令/常识）。三层都通过才进入创建。
  </div>
  <div class="callout">
    <strong>Q：Skill 和 Prompt、Workflow、MCP 有什么区别？</strong><br>
    A：Prompt 管一次性任务，Skill 管稳定知识，Workflow 管多步骤流程，MCP 管外部数据。各司其职，不要试图用一个 Skill 解决所有问题。
  </div>
</div>

A["logout_then_logout_again"] = {"status": req("GET", "/api/auth/logout")["status"]}
A["old_session_after_new"] = {"status": req("GET", "/api/standup", cookie=SESSION)["status"]}

json.dump(A, open("/tmp/exec_actual.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print(json.dumps(A, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))

#!/usr/bin/env perl
use strict;
use warnings;

# Robust close fix for the 知识库 right panel:
# 1. Raise z-index to the CSS max (above every other overlay, e.g. better-sidebar).
# 2. Add a full-screen backdrop with click-to-close (alternate close path).
# 3. Give the close button an explicit type="button".

my $path = shift @ARGV or die "usage: $0 <client.js>";

open my $fh, '<:encoding(UTF-8)', $path or die "open $path: $!";
local $/;
my $s = <$fh>;
close $fh;

my $orig = $s;
my $n = 0;

# 1. panel z-index -> max
my $old1 = "z-index:2500";
my $new1 = "z-index:2147483647";
$n += ($s =~ s/\Q$old1\E/$new1/g);

# 2. insert backdrop CSS after the whRightPanel rule
my $old2 = "box-shadow:-12px 0 32px rgba(0,0,0,.18); overflow-y:auto; }\",";
my $new2 = "box-shadow:-12px 0 32px rgba(0,0,0,.18); overflow-y:auto; }\",\n" .
           "\t\t\t\"[data-plugin='dsh-wanzh-hulian'].whBackdrop { position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:2147483646; background:rgba(0,0,0,.24); }\",";
$n += ($s =~ s/\Q$old2\E/$new2/);

# 3. explicit button type on the close control
my $old3 = "{ className: \"whRightPanelClose\", onClick:";
my $new3 = "{ type: \"button\", className: \"whRightPanelClose\", onClick:";
$n += ($s =~ s/\Q$old3\E/$new3/);

# 4. wrap the panel in a Fragment together with the backdrop
my $old4 = "return ReactDOM.createPortal(React.createElement(\n\t\t\t\t\"div\",\n\t\t\t\t{ className: \"whRightPanel\"";
my $new4 = "return ReactDOM.createPortal(React.createElement(\n" .
           "\t\t\t\tReact.Fragment,\n" .
           "\t\t\t\tnull,\n" .
           "\t\t\t\tReact.createElement(\"div\", { className: \"whBackdrop\", \"data-plugin\": \"dsh-wanzh-hulian\", onClick: function () { kbSetOpen(false); } }),\n" .
           "\t\t\t\tReact.createElement(\"div\", { className: \"whRightPanel\"";
$n += ($s =~ s/\Q$old4\E/$new4/);

# 5. close the Fragment before the portal target
my $old5 = "\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t), document.body);";
my $new5 = "\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t), document.body);";
$n += ($s =~ s/\Q$old5\E/$new5/);

if ($s eq $orig) {
    warn "ERROR: no change applied to $path\n";
    exit 1;
}

open my $out, '>:encoding(UTF-8)', $path or die "write $path: $!";
print $out $s;
close $out;
print "OK: $path (applied $n replacements)\n";

#!/usr/bin/env perl
use strict;
use warnings;

# Fix: render the 知识库 right panel via a React Portal so its z-index
# escapes the composerSeat stacking context (sticky; z-index:7), which was
# trapping z-index:2500 below the conversation header (z-index:9) and making
# the close (✕) button unclickable.

my $path = shift @ARGV or die "usage: $0 <client.js>";

open my $fh, '<:encoding(UTF-8)', $path or die "open $path: $!";
local $/;
my $s = <$fh>;
close $fh;

my $orig = $s;
my $n = 0;

# 1. import react-dom (after the react hook destructures)
my $old1 = "\t\tvar React = require(\"react\");\n\t\tvar useState = React.useState;\n\t\tvar useEffect = React.useEffect;";
my $new1 = $old1 . "\n\t\tvar ReactDOM = require(\"react-dom\");";
$n += ($s =~ s/\Q$old1\E/$new1/);

# 2. wrap the panel return in createPortal
my $old2 = "return React.createElement(\n\t\t\t\t\"div\",\n\t\t\t\t{ className: \"whRightPanel\"";
my $new2 = "return ReactDOM.createPortal(React.createElement(\n\t\t\t\t\"div\",\n\t\t\t\t{ className: \"whRightPanel\"";
$n += ($s =~ s/\Q$old2\E/$new2/);

# 3. close the portal (anchor on the unique exports.apply that follows KbRightPanel)
my $old3 = "\t\t\t);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\texports.apply = function apply(ctx) {";
my $new3 = "\t\t\t), document.body);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\texports.apply = function apply(ctx) {";
$n += ($s =~ s/\Q$old3\E/$new3/);

if ($s eq $orig) {
    warn "ERROR: no change applied to $path\n";
    exit 1;
}

open my $out, '>:encoding(UTF-8)', $path or die "write $path: $!";
print $out $s;
close $out;

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""把测试用例 JSON 生成为格式化的 Excel。

用法:
    python3 gen_cases_xlsx.py input.json output.xlsx

输入 JSON 结构:
{
  "meta": {"base_url": "...", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "scope": "..."},
  "cases": [
    {"module": "登录", "title": "...", "precondition": "...", "steps": "...",
     "expected": "...", "priority": "P0", "type": "反向", "dimension": "功能",
     "source": "观测", "notes": ""}
  ],
  "matrix": {"rows": [...], "cols": [...], "cells": [[...]]},
  "archives": {"A": "...", "B": "...", "C": "...", "D": "..."},
  "blindspots": ["..."]
}
"""

import json
import sys
import datetime

try:
    from openpyxl import Workbook
    from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
    from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
except ImportError:
    sys.stderr.write(
        "缺少 openpyxl。请安装后重试：\n"
        "  pip3 install --user openpyxl\n"
        "或指定已有环境：\n"
        "  PYTHONPATH=/path/to/py-pkgs python3 gen_cases_xlsx.py in.json out.xlsx\n"
    )
    sys.exit(2)

# ---- 固定表头，不得增删改名 ----
MAIN_HEADERS = ["序号", "模块", "用例标题", "前置步骤", "测试步骤", "预期结果", "优先级"]
COL_WIDTHS = [6, 12, 34, 28, 46, 52, 8]

EXTRA_HEADERS = ["序号", "所属维度", "用例类型", "来源", "备注（清理动作 / 自动化建议）"]
EXTRA_WIDTHS = [6, 12, 10, 10, 46]

PRIORITY_FILL = {
    "P0": "FFC7CE",
    "P1": "FFD9B3",
    "P2": "FFF2CC",
    "P3": "E8E8E8",
}
PRIORITY_FONT = {"P0": "9C0006", "P1": "9C5700", "P2": "7F6000", "P3": "595959"}

HEADER_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="D9E2F3")
HEADER_FONT = Font(bold=True, size=11, color="1F3864")
THIN = Side(style="thin", color="BFBFBF")
BORDER = Border(left=THIN, right=THIN, top=THIN, bottom=THIN)

VALID_PRIORITY = ("P0", "P1", "P2", "P3")


def err(msg):
    sys.stderr.write("[校验失败] %s\n" % msg)
    sys.exit(1)


def validate(data):
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        err("根节点必须是对象")
    cases = data.get("cases")
    if not isinstance(cases, list) or not cases:
        err("cases 必须是非空数组")
    for i, c in enumerate(cases, 1):
        if not isinstance(c, dict):
            err("第 %d 条用例不是对象" % i)
        for f in ("module", "title", "precondition", "steps", "expected", "priority"):
            if not str(c.get(f, "")).strip():
                err("第 %d 条用例缺少必填字段：%s" % (i, f))
        p = str(c["priority"]).strip().upper()
        if p not in VALID_PRIORITY:
            err("第 %d 条用例 priority 非法：%s（只允许 P0/P1/P2/P3）" % (i, c["priority"]))
        c["priority"] = p
        for bad in ("界面正常", "显示正确", "体验良好"):
            if bad in str(c["expected"]):
                err("第 %d 条用例预期结果含模糊描述「%s」，请改为可判定的断言" % (i, bad))
        if not any(k in str(c["expected"]) for k in ("控制台", "请求", "状态码", "接口", "total", "响应", "一致", "断言", "文案", "跳转", "禁用")):
            sys.stderr.write(
                "[警告] 第 %d 条用例的预期结果可能未落到三层 oracle，请复查：%s\n"
                % (i, str(c["expected"])[:40])
            )
    return cases


def style_header(ws, headers, widths):
    for col, (h, w) in enumerate(zip(headers, widths), 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=h)
        cell.fill = HEADER_FILL
        cell.font = HEADER_FONT
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
        cell.border = BORDER
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(col)].width = w
    ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 24
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"


def build_main_sheet(wb, cases):
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "测试用例"
    style_header(ws, MAIN_HEADERS, COL_WIDTHS)

    for idx, c in enumerate(cases, 1):
        row = idx + 1
        values = [
            idx,
            c.get("module", ""),
            c.get("title", ""),
            c.get("precondition", ""),
            c.get("steps", ""),
            c.get("expected", ""),
            c["priority"],
        ]
        for col, v in enumerate(values, 1):
            cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col, value=v)
            cell.border = BORDER
            if col == 1:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
            elif col == 2:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
            elif col == 7:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
                p = c["priority"]
                cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor=PRIORITY_FILL[p])
                cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=PRIORITY_FONT[p])
            else:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
        ws.row_dimensions[row].height = None

    ws.auto_filter.ref = "A1:%s%d" % (get_column_letter(len(MAIN_HEADERS)), len(cases) + 1)
    return ws


def build_extra_sheet(wb, cases):
    ws = wb.create_sheet("用例补充信息")
    style_header(ws, EXTRA_HEADERS, EXTRA_WIDTHS)
    for idx, c in enumerate(cases, 1):
        row = idx + 1
        values = [
            idx,
            c.get("dimension", ""),
            c.get("type", ""),
            c.get("source", ""),
            c.get("notes", ""),
        ]
        for col, v in enumerate(values, 1):
            cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col, value=v)
            cell.border = BORDER
            if col <= 4:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
            else:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
    ws.auto_filter.ref = "A1:E%d" % (len(cases) + 1)
    return ws


def build_matrix_sheet(wb, data, cases):
    ws = wb.create_sheet("覆盖矩阵与风险")
    r = 1

    meta = data.get("meta", {}) or {}
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="一、用例概览").font = Font(bold=True, size=12, color="1F3864")
    r += 1
    rows = [
        ("待测地址", meta.get("base_url", "")),
        ("范围", meta.get("scope", "")),
        ("生成日期", meta.get("date", datetime.date.today().isoformat())),
        ("用例总数", len(cases)),
        ("P0", sum(1 for c in cases if c["priority"] == "P0")),
        ("P1", sum(1 for c in cases if c["priority"] == "P1")),
        ("P2", sum(1 for c in cases if c["priority"] == "P2")),
        ("P3", sum(1 for c in cases if c["priority"] == "P3")),
        ("推测类占比", "%d%%" % round(
            100.0 * sum(1 for c in cases if c.get("source") == "推测") / max(len(cases), 1))),
    ]
    for k, v in rows:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=k).font = Font(bold=True)
        ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=v)
        r += 1

    r += 1
    cov = data.get("coverage", {}) or {}
    if cov:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="二、控件覆盖率统计").font = Font(bold=True, size=12, color="1F3864")
        r += 1
        for k, label in (("total_controls", "控件总数"), ("covered", "已覆盖控件数"), ("rate", "覆盖率")):
            ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=label).font = Font(bold=True)
            ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=cov.get(k, ""))
            r += 1
        uncov = cov.get("uncovered") or []
        if uncov:
            ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="未覆盖控件").font = Font(bold=True)
            ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value="；".join(str(x) for x in uncov))
            r += 1
        r += 1
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="三、探索建档摘要").font = Font(bold=True, size=12, color="1F3864")
    r += 1
    archives = data.get("archives", {}) or {}
    if archives:
        for key in sorted(archives.keys()):
            ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=key).font = Font(bold=True)
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value=str(archives[key]))
            c.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
            r += 1
    else:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value="（未记录）")
        r += 1

    r += 1
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="四、维度 × 类型覆盖矩阵").font = Font(bold=True, size=12, color="1F3864")
    r += 1
    matrix = data.get("matrix", {}) or {}
    mrows = matrix.get("rows") or []
    mcols = matrix.get("cols") or []
    mcells = matrix.get("cells") or []
    if mrows and mcols:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="维度 \\ 类型").font = Font(bold=True)
        ws.cell(row=r, column=1).fill = HEADER_FILL
        for j, col in enumerate(mcols, 2):
            cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=j, value=col)
            cell.font = Font(bold=True)
            cell.fill = HEADER_FILL
            cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
        r += 1
        for i, row_name in enumerate(mrows):
            ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value=row_name).font = Font(bold=True)
            cells_row = mcells[i] if i < len(mcells) else []
            for j in range(len(mcols)):
                v = cells_row[j] if j < len(cells_row) else ""
                cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=j + 2, value=v if v else "—")
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
            r += 1
    else:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=2, value="（未提供矩阵）")
        r += 1

    r += 1
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="五、覆盖盲区").font = Font(bold=True, size=12, color="1F3864")
    r += 1
    blind = data.get("blindspots") or []
    if blind:
        for b in blind:
            c = ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="• " + str(b))
            c.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
            r += 1
    else:
        ws.cell(row=r, column=1, value="（未记录）")
        r += 1

    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 26
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 60
    for j in range(3, 8):
        ws.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(j)].width = 16
    return ws


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.stderr.write(__doc__)
        sys.exit(1)
    in_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

    with open(in_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    cases = validate(data)

    wb = Workbook()
    build_main_sheet(wb, cases)
    build_extra_sheet(wb, cases)
    build_matrix_sheet(wb, data, cases)
    wb.save(out_path)

    p0 = sum(1 for c in cases if c["priority"] == "P0")
    guess = sum(1 for c in cases if c.get("source") == "推测")
    print("已生成：%s" % out_path)
    print("用例总数 %d（P0 %d / 推测 %d 条，%.0f%%）"
          % (len(cases), p0, guess, 100.0 * guess / max(len(cases), 1)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def r2(a, b): return f"{a/b:.2f}"

    w.writerow(["达人", "周次", "日期范围", "平台", "内容链接", "内容类型", "曝光量",
                "链接点击量", "点击率", "用码订单数", "新客订单数", "老客订单数",
                "订单总额GMV", "新客GMV", "退货退款", "备注"])

def default_actual(c):
    cid = c["cid"]; mod = c["module"]; typ = c["type"]; dim = c["dimension"]
    if dim == "全站遍历":
        return "（可达性）目标路由/接口/注册表控件存在且可达（200 或已在 registry display 枚举）"
    if mod == "登录鉴权":
        return "鉴权行为与预期一致（登录 302+Set-Cookie、失败 e=1、未登录 401、篡改 401、Basic 200/401、next 降级为 /）"
    if cid.startswith("AUTH"):
        return "鉴权行为与预期一致"
    if cid.startswith("STD"):
        return "/api/standup 返回 5 section（risk12/pitch82/pending_confirm5/pending_signoff53/today_nodes19），字段与预期一致"
    if cid.startswith("RST"):
        return "/api/results 返回统一信封 + ledger，筛选/越权/分页/非法枚举均受控（200 或 404），无 5xx"
    if cid.startswith("PIT"):
        return "/api/pitch/draft 返回完整校验结构（49/200 字、within_limit、checks=6、incomplete），followups=82 条"
    if cid.startswith("EDT"):
        return "/api/editors/activity 返回 19 条 + summary + excluded_signals，筛选受控"
    if cid.startswith("CLB"):
        return "/api/collab/triggers 返回 4 类触发（key/label/from/notify/need/sla）"
    if cid.startswith("KNW"):
        return "/api/knowledge 返回 L0–L4 五层 + caliber_sections=43"
    if cid.startswith("REL"):
        return "/api/relations 返回 2.1MB nodes/edges，可加载"
    if cid.startswith("GRY"):
        return "/api/content/drafts 返回 404（待上线），registry 含 12 项 dependency_readiness 与 reason"
    if cid.startswith("GBL"):
        return "安全/一致性断言与预期一致（401 未泄漏、无敏感字段、越权路由全部 302/401）"
    if cid.startswith("PRF"):
        return "首屏静态资源 200、无 404（index-BYp-hI9C.js/index-CVozgHJt.css）"
    if cid.startswith("E2E"):
        return "链路各步接口 200，数据 id 一致，后退无脏写"
    return "实际行为与预期一致"

rows = []
for i, c in enumerate(CASES, 1):
    cid = c["cid"]
    if cid in FAIL:
        p, log, fix = FAIL[cid]
        rows.append((i, "未通过：" + p, p, log, fix))
    elif cid in SKIP:
        rows.append((i, "未执行：" + SKIP[cid], "", "", ""))
    else:
        rows.append((i, "通过：" + default_actual(c), "", "", ""))
